job.title: Software Development Engineer, Selling Partner Trust
job.pay_full: $143,700 – $194,400 a year base salary (Tempe), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: The Selling Partner Trust team protects Amazon's buyers, brand owners and sellers from bad actors, abuse and fraud, aiming to give buyers and sellers the most trusted experience. Engineers build automation and experiences on big data sets and distributed frameworks, and high-performance services that handle millions of requests a day at millisecond latency under strict SLAs.
duties: Conceptualize, design, build, test and own software systems for seller trust experiences
Build services that handle millions of requests a day with millisecond latency and strict SLAs
Develop automation using big data sets and distributed frameworks
Help drive the team's technical direction across many technologies
Design, code, troubleshoot and support production systems
needs: 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
Experience programming with at least one software programming language
3+ years of full software development life cycle experience: coding standards, code reviews, source control, build processes, testing and operations
3+ years of computer science fundamentals: object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, problem solving and complexity analysis
nice: Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
details.benefits: Base salary $143,700 – $194,400 a year (Tempe, AZ). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, life and AD&D insurance, mental health support, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities

yt_title: Amazon Is Hiring: Software Engineer, Seller Trust | Tempe, AZ | $144K–$194K

scenes.head: The role
lines: Now hiring in Tempe, Arizona! Amazon wants a Software Development Engineer for Selling Partner Trust, the team that protects buyers and sellers from fraud and abuse.

scenes.head: What you'll do
bullets: Millions of requests a day, low latency
lines: You'll design, build, and own services that handle millions of requests a day in milliseconds, using big data and distributed systems.
And you'll help shape the team's technical direction.

scenes.head: What you need
lines: You'll need three years of professional software development, two years designing systems for reliability and scale, and strong computer science fundamentals.
Plus three years across the full software life cycle, from code reviews to testing and operations.
